newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures mixed in thin trade.

text.p: U.S. energy futures prices were mixed in thin NYMEX ACCESS trade, with gasoline up on short covering while heating oil and crude were weighed by profit-taking.
Activity was light, traders, as players avoided the market after sharp NYMEX increases and before Tuesday's key inventory figures from the American Petroleum Institute.
NYMEX gasoline for January delivery traded 69.90 cents a gallon, up 0.38 cents after rising 2.48 cents during the day.
About 165 lots changed hands in gasoline overnight and 250 traded in all months.
Front-month heating oil eased 0.17 cents a gallon to 74.82 cents amid light activity of 70 lots. Around 200 lots changed hands overnight.
After-hours, January crude eased two cents to $25.72 a barrel, as 405 lots traded in the front-month with 800 exchanged overall.
